notes: Sold in W (white) and K (black) color variants (AW-UE50W/AW-UE50K); I/O is identical across colors. This is a PTZ camera (desktop or ceiling-suspended), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. HDMI is version 1.4 (4:2:2/10-bit, HDCP not supported). SDI output is 3G-SDI (SMPTE292M/424M, BNC, Level-A/B selectable). LAN (RJ-45) is 100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T and also carries PoE+ (IEEE802.3at) for camera power - modeled as a single bidirectional RJ45 network port; PoE+ power delivery over this same port is noted here rather than as a separate power port since it is an alternative to the DC IN jack, not a mandatory second supply. A separate CONTROL IN port uses RS-422A over an RJ-45-style connector for serial camera control (distinct physical connector from the LAN port) - modeled with connector rs422 per the port list's control-protocol categorization; note it is physically an RJ-45 shell. DC 12V IN accepts 10.8-13.2V DC from the supplied AC adapter; exact barrel diameter not published by Panasonic, so classified as the closest match (dc-barrel). USB2.0 Type-C port is UVC-only (webcam-style video class) and does not supply bus power; grade omitted because Panasonic does not state a USB speed class beyond "USB2.0" generically tied to the UVC function rather than a data-transfer spec, but usb-2.0 is the correct grade per the stated USB2.0 spec. No genlock, tally, GPIO, or SD card slot are listed in the manufacturer specifications.
